summary.headline: Update Ring policy settings reference added
summary.summary: A reference article was added for Windows Update settings manageable through Intune Update Ring policies.
summary.adminImpact: Use the reference to evaluate available update-ring controls before policy design.

summary.headline: Windows Update Ring settings policy reference added
summary.summary: A new reference article documents Windows Update settings available through Intune Update Ring policies.
summary.adminImpact: Use this new reference when selecting update ring settings.

summary.headline: Update ring settings page restructured
summary.summary: The former settings page removes its introductory Update settings text and renames its main section to Update rings settings as content moves to policy-specific references.
summary.adminImpact: Follow the current update rings policy settings reference for configuration details.

summary.headline: Update ring settings add driver and deferral controls
summary.summary: The settings table adds Windows drivers Allow/Block with the ExcludeWUDriversInQualityUpdate CSP and explains 0–30 day quality update deferrals; it also corrects the Microsoft Update CSP link.
summary.adminImpact: Set Windows drivers to Allow if drivers should scan from Windows Update, and choose quality deferrals appropriate to your servicing cadence.

summary.headline: Migrate to Intune article date refreshed
summary.summary: The patch updates the article date from December 15, 2025 to January 8, 2026 and removes a blank line.
summary.adminImpact: No migration guidance changed in this patch.

summary.headline: Assignment filters now supported for Settings Catalog DDM
summary.summary: The supported-workloads table changes Settings catalog (DDM) from unsupported to supported.
summary.adminImpact: Administrators can plan assignment filters for declarative device management Settings Catalog workloads.

summary.headline: Update ring prerelease setting adds CSP reference
summary.summary: The settings table adds the BranchReadinessLevel CSP reference to Enable pre-release builds and removes a general behavior-reference sentence.
summary.adminImpact: Use the CSP reference when validating prerelease build configuration.

summary.headline: Expedited updates article touched for reference migration
summary.summary: The patch contains no changed content lines for this article, consistent with a documentation-structure migration.
summary.adminImpact: No administrator action is indicated by the patch.

summary.headline: Windows 10 feature update links move to new policy references
summary.summary: The article links multiple-policy behavior to update-rings-policy-settings.md and replaces a creation-section link with the feature updates article root.
summary.adminImpact: Continue moving Windows 10 devices ineligible for Windows 11 to a Windows 10 feature update policy.

summary.headline: Update rings setup links to new settings reference
summary.summary: The policy creation steps now direct administrators to update-rings-policy-settings.md instead of settings.md for available Update ring settings.
summary.adminImpact: Use the new update rings policy settings reference while creating ring policies.
